minutes.headline: Board appointed Carl Luck to the Conservation Commission, with the chair voicing a policy objection to dual office-holding.
minutes.summary: The board heard public comment on the Marshall Park parking dispute, town meeting participation and the water district. It read two proclamations, took committee reports on building reuse and capital planning, and made a conservation appointment. The planning room dedication was postponed.

public_comment.topic: Asked the board to take responsibility for or help resolve the Marshall Park off-street parking project affecting a Chestnut Street abutter.
Described nine months of trying to resolve tree and stone wall damage, a claim she heard was withdrawn, and her wish for an alternative parking location.
Raised the disconnect between residents and town commissions and the water district, and asked how to improve participation.
Said volunteering and a heritage of service should inspire more people to get involved.

public_comment.stated_role: chairman of the Lunenburg Water District
public_comment.topic: Clarified the water district is a separate autonomous entity under the Acts of 1939 and asked for stage seating at the May 19 joint meeting.

votes.motion: Appoint Carl Luck to the Conservation Commission with a term to expire June 30th 2015

budget_items.topic: Mailing town warrant to every household
budget_items.what_was_said: The cost of mailing the town meeting notice to every household was given.
The board read the payroll, deduction, school construction and accounts payable warrants.
The regional transit advisory board approved its FY16 budget and expects an FY15 deficit that the state will advance and be repaid in FY16.

decisions.decision: Board will try to schedule a meeting among the parties on the Marshall Park parking dispute soon.
Dedication of the planning board meeting room continued to May 19 or June pending the planning board.
Articles 39 to 47 will carry over to a fall special town meeting.
Joint meeting with water commissioners set for May 19.

what_happened.line: The board appointed a member to the Conservation Commission for a term ending June 30, 2015; the vote tally was not audible, and the chair voiced a policy objection to dual office-holding.
The board said it will try to schedule a meeting among the parties on the Marshall Park parking dispute soon, after an abutter described months of unresolved damage.
A joint meeting with the water commissioners was set for May 19.
Articles 39 to 47 will carry over to a fall special town meeting.
Dedication of the planning board meeting room was continued to May 19 or June, pending the planning board.

why_it_matters: The Marshall Park parking project is a town-backed project affecting a neighbor's property, and no resolution or owner of responsibility was set at this meeting.
Carrying Articles 39 to 47 to a fall special town meeting means residents will be asked to vote on them later, not at the spring town meeting.
watch_next: Joint meeting of the Select Board and water commissioners on May 19.
A fall special town meeting taking up Articles 39 to 47, and the rescheduled planning room dedication on May 19 or in June.
